messages:
Priya: heads-up — DAST premerge started failing on the payments service. pipeline log shows artifact upload failing with 403 when encrypting with the org KMS key.
scan-bot: automatic alert: DAST job #4723 failed: S3PutObject (AccessDenied) -> KMS:Encrypt denied for arn:aws:iam::1234567890:role/scan-service-account.
Maria: ok, likely RBAC issue — the scanner role needs kms:Encrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey on the specific key. we should avoid broad kms:* permissions.
Alex: do we have an existing policy template for scanner SA? would prefer to reuse instead of ad-hoc change. also want CloudTrail visibility for these operations.
TJ: quick question — is the scanner uploading raw payloads that might contain PII? need to know if we should route to restricted bucket.
Priya: it's uploading HTML screenshots + HTTP traces. minimal PII but still covered by infra-data policy. we encrypt at rest with KMS and want full audit trail.
Maria: suggested policy snippet (least privilege):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234567890:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-dast-artifacts/*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Maria: plus add condition to require "aws:RequestTag/scan-run" = "dast" so uploads from other actors can be denied.
Alex: adding CloudTrail read for kms:Encrypt and s3:PutObject to the security logs is fine. do we want a separate log retention for artifacts ops?
Priya: yes, 1 year retention for artifact access logs per compliance. also add an alert on kms:Decrypt by non-scanner principals.
TJ: temporary mitigation — can we fall back to storing artifacts in ephemeral non-encrypted bucket for CI so scans continue? worried about breaking triage data.
Maria: i don't want that. let's avoid unencrypted storage. temporary mitigation: mark the pipeline to skip artifact upload (still run scan) and attach raw scan output to the PR comment instead. less useful but safer.
oncall: i'm on it — will toggle pipeline flag for the affected jobs in CI within 10 mins. @Priya please confirm which job ids.
Priya: thanks. job ids: payments-dast-1, payments-dast-2. also open a PR to update IAM policy and tag rule.
Alex: on the RBAC PR, add a unit test that simulates encryption call with stubbed kms to assert permissions are scoped. will review.
Maria: also flag for SAST team — we saw correlated SAST noise in the same repo last week; let's ensure suppression rules are not accidentally allowing high severity to be skipped.
Priya: noted. I'll loop in @TJ and the SAST squad to run an evidence sweep.
TJ: one more ask — can we emit the scan id as a stable trace id in CloudTrail events? helps join pieces in incident response.
Maria: yes, we'll set RequestTag scan-id and include the PR number. security playbook update: require scan-id tagging and CloudTrail linkage for any artifact encryption/upload events.
Priya: thanks everyone. action items: (1) oncall toggle pipeline to skip upload (oncall) (2) create RBAC PR with least-priv policy + tag condition (Maria) (3) update CloudTrail alert rules + retention (Alex) (4) coordinate SAST evidence sweep (TJ). I'll follow up with a short postmortem if anything interesting turns up. :thumbsup:
scan-bot: ticket created: SEC-DAST-2026, assigned to Maria.
